rules.name: grasa-month-vol-by-name-cfs
rules.sql: WITH pm(product, contract_month) AS (VALUES ('CM BO','F27.F27'), ('CM BO','H27.H27'), ('CM BO','Z26.Z26'), ('CM C','N27.N27'), ('CM C','U27.U27'), ('CM C','Z26.Z26'), ('CM CRD','U27.U27'), ('CM CT','H27.H27'), ('CM CT','K27.K27'), ('CM CT','N27.N27'), ('CM CT','Z26.Z26'), ('CM CT','Z27.Z27'), ('CM KC','Z26.Z26'), ('CM KO','F27.F27'), ('CM MW','Z27.Z27'), ('CM OR','X26.X26'), ('CM OR','Z26.Z26'), ('CM OR EUR','F27.F27'), ('CM OR EUR','G27.G27'), ('CM OR EUR','H27.H27'), ('CM OR EUR','J27.J27'), ('CM OR EUR','K27.K27'), ('CM OR EUR','M27.M27'), ('CM OR EUR','N27.N27'), ('CM OR EUR','Q27.Q27'), ('CM OR EUR','X26.X26'), ('CM OR EUR','Z26.Z26'), ('CM QC','Z26.Z26'), ('CM S','H27.H27'), ('CM S','K27.K27'), ('CM S','N27.N27'), ('CM S','X26.X26'), ('CM SB','H27.H27'), ('CM SM','F27.F27'), ('CM SM','H27.H27'), ('CM SM','K27.K27'), ('CM SM','Z26.Z26'), ('CM W','Z26.Z26')), vd AS (SELECT value_date FROM opera.valuation_date_table WHERE upper(business_unit) = :bu LIMIT 1) SELECT pm.product, pm.contract_month, sv.vol_id, COUNT(sv.*) AS surface_rows, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE upper(sv.call_put_id) = 'C') AS call_rows FROM pm LEFT JOIN opera.settlement_vol_surf_table sv ON sv.value_date = (SELECT value_date FROM vd) AND regexp_replace(sv.vol_id, '\s+', ' ', 'g') = split_part(pm.product, ' ', 1) || ' ' || split_part(pm.product, ' ', 2) || ' ' || pm.contract_month GROUP BY pm.product, pm.contract_month, sv.vol_id ORDER BY pm.product, pm.contract_month
